purpose: provider-neutral design content, not a working mod configuration

cities.name: Valewood
cities.subtitle: Agricultural & Trade Federation
cities.description: A prosperous rural municipality built around food, vineyards, and regional commerce. Grow a business, influence local trade routes, and protect a city dependent on imports.

cities.name: Ironhaven
cities.subtitle: Industrial City-State
cities.description: An industrial metropolis where factories, workshops, corporate contracts, and city security provide opportunity while labor disputes and corruption shape daily life.

cities.name: Blackwater
cities.subtitle: Urban Commercial Freeport
cities.description: A dense commercial city with powerful private interests, technology companies, security checkpoints, and a thriving but risky underground marketplace.

professions.name: Farmer / Vintner
professions.description: Cultivate crops, operate vineyards, produce quality beverages and food, negotiate sales, and expand into an agricultural business.
starter_objectives: Plant and harvest a starter crop

professions.name: Smith / Engineer
professions.description: Repair equipment, process ores and parts, improve production machinery, and supply civilian construction and industrial projects.

professions.name: Gunsmith / Arms Dealer
professions.description: Learn firearm repair and safe licensed manufacture, discover blueprints, supply legitimate security clients, or risk illegal underground trade.

professions.name: Hacker / Technician
professions.description: Maintain terminals and infrastructure, build automation, provide defensive cybersecurity, and take fictional in-game network infiltration contracts.
starter_objectives: Install or repair a client security device
